critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/bot/config takes min_confidence_override as int (0-100 percentage). Pydantic rejects floats with 422. UI / API docs should make this explicit so callers don't pass 0.7.

Bridge endpoints are POST-only (/heartbeat, /poll-trades, /external-deal, /report, /modification-ack). The review_request mentioned 'GET /api/bridge/poll' which does not exist — recommend documenting the actual EA-facing surface to avoid confusion.

Auto-heal background loop confirmed scheduled at startup (server.py:_auto_heal_task = asyncio.create_task(_auto_heal_loop())). Loop interval is hard-coded inside _auto_heal_loop; would be cleaner as AUTO_HEAL_INTERVAL_SEC env var.

tests/test_iter45_postmortem.py imports loss_postmortem directly — only collectable when pytest runs from /app/backend (not /app). Pre-existing pattern in this repo, fine for now, but adding conftest.py sys.path bootstrapping at /app would unify test invocation.
